findings.highlight: all I remember is that we went to sleep next to each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 隣で桜が眠っている経緯だけは憶えている
findings.governingReading: 経緯 identifies the circumstances/process leading to her being next to him, which alone he retains amid identity failure.
findings.explanation: Remembering how she came to sleep beside him becomes remembering only that they slept together.

findings.highlight: I end up getting lost in thought for ten seconds.
findings.evidenceJa: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる
findings.governingReading: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる describes finding himself ten seconds further on when attempting thought.
findings.explanation: Lost time when trying to think becomes getting lost in thought.

findings.highlight: She must have washed up, made breakfast, trained in the dojo, and did laundry in the backyard.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を洗っていたり朝食の準備をしていたり道場で稽古をしていたり庭で洗濯をしていたりする
findings.governingReading: たり lists candidate ongoing things Sakura might be doing to explain her absence: washing, cooking, training, laundry.
findings.explanation: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.

findings.highlight: She must have washed up, made breakfast, trained in the dojo, and did laundry in the backyard.
findings.evidenceJa: 庭で洗濯をしていたりする
findings.governingReading: The listed hypothesized activities require coherent English verb coordination.
findings.explanation: A coordinated perfect auxiliary is followed by did.
